summary: Farmers & Merchants Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a routine extension of its shareholder rights plan (poison pill) until July 29, 2027. The Second Amendment to the Rights Agreement extends the expiration date by one year; no other terms, premiums, prices, or structural changes were disclosed. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private, or other special situation. The filing merely amends an existing antitakeover measure and is classified as a routine current report. No actionable special-situation event is present.
